newsitem.title: FRANCE: Anti-abortion activists arrested in France.
newsitem.headline: Anti-abortion activists arrested in France.

text.p: REIMS, France, Sept 27, Reuter - French police arrested eight anti-abortion activists, four of them American, who had entered a hospital in the eastern city of Reims on Friday and refused to leave, local officials said.
The activists were taken away without resistance after local government officials failed to persuade them to leave. They are being detained in police custody.
Illegal protests against abortion, which was legalised in France 21 years ago, have increased in recent years.
